text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I woke up early to do some extra
training...
Before I knew it, the sun had
set.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I was so absorbed in training... I lost
track of
time...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Or perhaps, the flow of time distorted
as it
passed through another dimension...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...If it means I can catch up with my
friend, then
maybe that's not such a bad
thing... hehe.
